# Weight Loss Percentage Calculator — Complete AI & LLM Specification

---

## SECTION 1: CORE MATHEMATICAL FORMULAS

### 1.1 Weight Loss Percentage Formula
```
Percentage Lost (%) = ((Starting Weight − Current Weight) / Starting Weight) × 100
```
- **Example:** Starting = 200 lbs, Current = 180 lbs.
  `((200 − 180) / 200) × 100 = (20 / 200) × 100 = 10%`

### 1.2 Body Mass Index (BMI) Formulas
- **Imperial:** `BMI = (Weight in lbs / (Height in inches)²) × 703`
- **Metric:** `BMI = Weight in kg / (Height in meters)²`
- **WHO Classification Thresholds:**
  - Underweight: `< 18.5`
  - Normal Weight: `18.5 – 24.9`
  - Overweight: `25.0 – 29.9`
  - Obesity Class I: `30.0 – 34.9`
  - Obesity Class II: `35.0 – 39.9`
  - Obesity Class III (Severe): `≥ 40.0`

### 1.3 Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) Formulas
- **Mifflin-St Jeor Equation (Clinical Standard):**
  - Men: `BMR = (10 × weight in kg) + (6.25 × height in cm) − (5 × age in years) + 5`
  - Women: `BMR = (10 × weight in kg) + (6.25 × height in cm) − (5 × age in years) − 161`
- **Revised Harris-Benedict Equation:**
  - Men: `BMR = (13.397 × kg) + (4.799 × cm) − (5.677 × age) + 88.362`
  - Women: `BMR = (9.247 × kg) + (3.098 × cm) − (4.330 × age) + 447.593`

### 1.4 Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE)
`TDEE = BMR × Activity Multiplier`
- Sedentary (little to no exercise): `1.2`
- Lightly Active (1–3 days/week): `1.375`
- Moderately Active (3–5 days/week): `1.55`
- Very Active (6–7 days/week): `1.725`
- Extra Active (physical job & training): `1.9`

### 1.5 US Navy Body Fat Percentage Formula
- **Men:** `BF% = 86.010 × log10(abdomen − neck) − 70.041 × log10(height) + 36.76` (measurements in inches)
- **Women:** `BF% = 163.205 × log10(waist + hip − neck) − 97.684 × log10(height) − 78.387`

---

## SECTION 2: PEDIATRIC & SPECIALIZED CLINICAL GUIDELINES

### 2.1 Newborn Weight Loss Thresholds
- **Normal Physiological Weight Loss:** 5% to 7% of birth weight within first 3–4 days.
- **Warning Level:** 7% to 10% requires lactation support and feeding evaluation.
- **Critical Threshold:** `≥ 10%` signals potential dehydration/failure to thrive; immediate clinical intervention required.
- **Birth Weight Recovery Target:** Full birth weight restored by day 10–14 post-birth.

### 2.2 GLP-1 Medication Trajectory Standards
- **Semaglutide (Wegovy / Ozempic):** 10% to 15% average total body weight loss at 68 weeks (STEP-1 trial baseline).
- **Tirzepatide (Zepbound / Mounjaro):** 15% to 20.9% average weight loss at 72 weeks (SURMOUNT-1 trial baseline).

### 2.3 Bariatric Surgery %EWL (Excess Weight Loss)
`%EWL = ((Pre-op Weight − Current Weight) / (Pre-op Weight − Ideal Weight)) × 100`
